meanings: mug or jug used for serving beer

makemeahanzi.definition: to bind, to wrap; to pierce; to stop

etymology.hint: A hand 扌 tying a bundle with string 乚

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 扎 describes a hand at work tying or binding something.
乚 depicts a bent length of string or cord — bound by the hand 扌, it gave 扎 its meaning 'to tie, to bundle.'

makemeahanzi.definition: system; to establish; to manufacture; to overpower

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (knife) — 制 relates to cutting and shaping, and by extension, to making or controlling something.
巾 (jīn) gives a hint of the sound — 制 is pronounced zhì, a connection that has drifted over time.

etymology.hint: A group of people that swear by 矢 a single flag 方

characterDeckComponents.note: 方 (a flag/banner) — a shared banner under which a group gathers.
矢 (arrow) — warriors bound by oath under one flag gave 族 its meaning 'clan, ethnic group, tribe.'
氵 (water) — 澡 describes washing the body with water.
喿 (zào) gives a sound close to zǎo, the same syllable with a different tone.

meanings: to heat (sth) up in hot water

makemeahanzi.definition: to scald; to iron clothes or hair

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — 烫 relates to intense heat.
汤 (tāng) gives a sound close to 烫's reading tàng, sharing the base syllable and differing only in tone.

makemeahanzi.definition: side; to slant, to lean, to incline

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 侧 originally described a person standing to one side.
则 (zé) gives a sound close to cè.

makemeahanzi.definition: to eat, to dine; meal, food

characterDeckComponents.note: 食 (food) — 餐 relates directly to eating and meals.

makemeahanzi.definition: foot; to attain, to satisfy; enough

etymology.hint: The leg 口 above the foot

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 depicts a leg (the upper shape) above a foot — a simple picture of the human leg and foot, giving 足 its meaning 'foot, to be sufficient.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to change; to exchange, to trade; simple, easy

etymology.hint: A metal 钅 nail 丁; 丁 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 钅 (metal) shows what the nail is made of.
丁 depicts the simple shape of a nail or peg.

makemeahanzi.definition: moreover, also (post-subject); about to, will soon (pre-verb)

characterDeckComponents.note: Originally a pictograph of a stone altar or ancestral tablet; its later use as the grammatical word 且, 'moreover, and,' has no connection to that original picture.

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 異; a person 共 with a scary face田

characterDeckComponents.note: 异 (a simplified form of 異) depicts a person with upraised hands and an odd expression, suggesting something strange or different.

makemeahanzi.definition: to leak, to drip; hour glass; funnel

etymology.hint: Water 氵 falling like raindrops 雨; 屚 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 漏 describes water escaping through a gap.
屚 pictures rain seeping in through a roof, the image behind 漏's meaning 'to leak.'
青 (blue-green, nature) — 静 relates to a calm stillness, like still water or clear skies
争 (zhēng) gives a sound distantly related to 静's reading jìng, having drifted apart over time

etymology.hint: A happy 喜 sound 口; 喜 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) shows this is a sound made with the mouth.
喜 depicts joy or happiness — together with the mouth radical, giving 嘻 its meaning of a happy, laughing sound.

etymology.hint: A silken thread 糸 hanging off a tree 龶

characterDeckComponents.note: 糸 (thread) — plain, undyed silk thread
龶 — a plant stem, from which the raw silk thread hangs
欠 (to lack) — wanting something you lack ties to 欲's meaning 'desire.'
谷 (gǔ) gives a sound distantly related to yù, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: ear; to hear, to hear of; handle

characterDeckComponents.note: 耳 is a simplified picture of the outer shape of a human ear.

makemeahanzi.definition: to command, to lead; rate, ratio, proportion

etymology.hint: A string 幺 vibrating in an instrument 亠十

characterDeckComponents.note: 率 originally depicted a twisted cord or string 幺 being pulled taut in a frame — later extended to meanings like 'to lead' (pulling something along) and 'rate, ratio.'
矢 (arrow, dart) — an old link between measuring length and the character's meaning.
委 (wěi) gives a sound distantly related to ǎi, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: roar or howl of an animal

makemeahanzi.definition: to roar, to shout; to bark, to howl

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 吼 describes a loud sound made with the mouth, a roar.
孔 (kǒng) gives a sound distantly related to 吼's reading hǒu, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to build, to design; to establish; to offer

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — relates to 设's meaning 'to establish, set up,' something first proposed through words.
殳 (shū) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from shè.

makemeahanzi.definition: to give, to donate; to give up, to renounce

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 捐 describes giving something with one's hands, donating.
肙 (juān) gives the sound — an exact match with 捐.
米 (grain, especially husked rice) — 精's meaning 'refined, essence, spirit' relates to rice refined to its purest form.
青 (qīng) gives a sound hint — 精 is pronounced jīng, sharing the same rhyme though the initial consonant differs.

meanings: after or at an interval of

makemeahanzi.definition: to separate, to partition, to divide

characterDeckComponents.note: 阝 (mound, related to walls) — 隔 describes something separated by a barrier.
鬲 (gé) is an exact match for the sound of 隔.

makemeahanzi.definition: ruler, tape-measure; unit of length, about 1 ft.

etymology.hint: Picture of a man measuring by pacing

characterDeckComponents.note: 尺 is traditionally read as a picture of a bent leg taking a measured step, used before rulers existed to pace off a distance — the origin of its meaning 'a Chinese foot, a ruler.'

meanings: classifier for tables of guests at a banquet etc
classifier for trees, cabbages, plants etc

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood/tree) — 棵 is used specifically to count trees and similar plants.
果 (guǒ) gives a sound distantly related to 棵's reading kē, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: used in 囉唆|啰唆[luo1 suo5] and 囉嗦|啰嗦[luo1 suo5]

makemeahanzi.definition: to dispute, to fight, to contend, to strive

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 爭, two hands 爪 and 彐 fighting over 亅

characterDeckComponents.note: 爪 and 彐 (two hands, reaching from opposite sides) — a simplified form of 爭, grabbing for the same thing.
亅 (the object) — what the two hands are struggling over, giving 争 its meaning 'to contend, compete, fight for.'

meanings: non-Han people, esp. from central Asia
to complete a winning hand at mahjong

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺼ (flesh) — 胡 originally referred to the flesh under an animal's chin or throat
古 (gǔ) gives the sound — an exact match with 胡's reading hú
欠 (to owe/lack) — 款 relates to funds, especially money owed or paid

makemeahanzi.definition: to surround, to encircle, to corral

characterDeckComponents.note: 囗 (an enclosure) — 围 relates to surrounding or encircling something
韦 (wéi) gives the sound — 围 is also pronounced wéi, an exact match

etymology.hint: The stomach ⺼ behind the abdominal muscles 田

characterDeckComponents.note: 田 here pictures the stomach itself, reused from its usual meaning 'field.'
⺼ (flesh) sits below, marking 胃 as a body part.
兄 (elder brother, i.e. companion) — 党's meaning 'party, group, faction' relates to people bonded like brothers.
尚 (shàng) served as the phonetic base; its pronunciation has since drifted well away from dǎng.

makemeahanzi.definition: to prevent, to restrict, to stop; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — 杜 names a kind of tree, the birchleaf pear.
土 (tǔ) gives a sound close to dù.
A drawing of a robe's collar and folded sides, seen from the front.

makemeahanzi.definition: to carve, to engrave; a quarter hour; a moment

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (a knife) — 刻 relates to carving with a blade
亥 (hài) is the historical phonetic element; it no longer closely matches 刻's modern reading kè

meanings: (particle in old Chinese similar to 啊)

etymology.hint: A dog turned to the side

characterDeckComponents.note: 犬 is a simplified picture of a dog seen from the side, with its head, back, and legs traced in a few strokes.
木 (wood) — cabinets are traditionally made of wood.
巨 (jù) gives a sound distantly related to guì, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: noun prefix denoting function or status

etymology.hint: A man from a good 良 place 阝;  良 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 良 (good) — 郎 originally described a fine, well-regarded man.
阝 (a settlement, a place) — a good man 良 from a certain place 阝 gave 郎 its meaning 'a young man, a gentleman.'

makemeahanzi.definition: a kind of sedge grass that used to be woven into raincoats

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass) — 莎 originally named a type of sedge grass.
沙 (shā) gives the sound — an exact match with 莎.

makemeahanzi.definition: to gamble, to play games; to win; rich, plentiful, extensive; wide, broad

characterDeckComponents.note: 十 (ten) — 博 relates to breadth, with ten symbolizing completeness.
尃 (fū) reflects the character's historical phonetic root, though the modern reading bó has diverged considerably.
扌 (hand) — the hand radical, marking the character as related to an action performed with the hand.
甬 (yǒng) gives a sound close to 捅's reading tǒng, sharing the same final -ong.
立 (to stand) — 端 relates to standing upright, being straight and proper.
耑 (duān) gives the sound — an exact match with 端.

meanings: (bound form) to have in one's control

makemeahanzi.definition: to grasp, to hold, to take by the hand

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 握 describes an action done with the hand: grasping tightly.
屋 (wū) gives a sound distantly related to wò, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A sea shell, once used as currency

characterDeckComponents.note: The character traces the rounded shell and radiating lines of a cowrie shell, once used as ancient Chinese currency.

makemeahanzi.definition: juice, liquor, fluid; sap; gravy, sauce

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 汁 names a liquid.
十 (shí) gives a sound distantly related to zhī, having drifted apart over time.
